newsitem.title: JAPAN: Obayashi consortium wins Bangkok subway order.
newsitem.headline: Obayashi consortium wins Bangkok subway order.

text.p: Obayashi Corp said on Thursday that a consortium comprising Nishimatsu Construction Co Ltd, Italian Thai Development Plc and Obayashi had won a 140.7 billion yen order to design and build the northern section of Bangkok's new subway.
The order was placed by Thailand's Metropolitan Rapid Transit Authority (MRTA), the state agency responsible for development of the subway, an Obayashi spokesman said.
Obayashi and Nishimatsu are major Japanese general contractors while Italian-Thai is Thailand's largest construction company.
The 10.7 km long northern section will contain nine stations, the Obayashi spokesman said.
Construction will begin later this month and is expected to be completed in May 2002, he said.
A contract to build the southern section of the subway was awarded to a consortium headed by Thai construction firm Ch Karnchang Public Co Ltd last year.
